newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: South Africa Maize Board delays pool delivery payments.
newsitem.headline: South Africa Maize Board delays pool delivery payments.

text.p: South Africa's Maize Board said on Friday supplementary payments for deliveries into its export pools could not be made before the end of January 1997.
It said the reason for this was that the board had conducted some forward sales for which dollar payments would only be received later.
"As the rate of exchange is at present very volatile, it is too risky to do calculations in advance and to base supplementary payments on such calculations," Vic Mouton, the board's chairman said.
He said profits made from hedging activities may also influence the realisation of the pools.
"The board will nevertheless endeavour to make certain supplementary payments to deliveries by the end of January 1997," Mouton said. --Johannesburg newsroom 27 11 482 1003
